check_gender.description: Check whether a first name matches the gender you expect, to catch a wrong salutation before it goes out, or to clean up a contact list where someone was filed as Mr when they should be Ms. Answers yes or no, along with the likely gender and the right salutation. A name that could be either is never a match.
check_gender.name: check_gender

parameters.description: The first name to look up, such as Andrea or Jean-Luc. Send the first name on its own where you can: a surname tells Vornamencheck nothing.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The gender you have on record for this person, such as the one behind the salutation in your contact list.
parameters.name: expected_gender

parameters.description: The country whose naming customs to go by. The same name can differ: Andrea is usually female in Germany and usually male in Italy. Germany if you leave it as it is.
parameters.name: country

certainty_percent.description: How likely the gender given is, from 50 (a coin toss) to 100 (certain).

country.description: Two-letter code of the country the answer applies to.

country_name.description: Name of the country the answer applies to.

female_percent.description: How likely the name is female, out of 100.

gender.description: male or female, whichever is more likely. unknown when both are equally likely, as with a surname or a word that is not a name.

german_salutation.description: Herr or Frau, for a letter or email in German. Empty when unknown.

is_known.description: True when the name leans one way. Put this in an If step before using the gender or the salutation.

male_percent.description: How likely the name is male, out of 100.

matches.description: True when the name is more likely the gender you expected. False when it is more likely the other one, or could be either.

name.description: The first name, with capital letters where they belong.

note.description: A remark from Vornamencheck about the name, if it has one.

salutation.description: Mr or Ms, to address the person by. Empty when unknown.

get_gender.description: Find out whether a first name is male or female in a country you choose, with how likely each is and the salutation to use: Mr or Ms, and Herr or Frau for German. Use it to greet a new sign-up correctly or to fill in a missing salutation. A name Vornamencheck has never seen takes a few seconds the first time; after that it is instant.

description: Find out whether a first name is male or female, the way it is used in a particular country, with Vornamencheck. Andrea is usually female in Germany and usually male in Italy, and Vornamencheck knows the difference for 249 countries. Every answer comes with how likely it is and the salutation to use, so a workflow can greet a new contact correctly or catch a wrong Mr or Ms in a contact list. No account or API key required.
